svg.text: SQL · S01 · INNER vs LEFT — multiplication and the WHERE trap
Two tables plus the LEFT result — Bob stays with NULL.
INNER drops gaps. 1:N multiplies the parent.
No match: INNER drops it. LEFT keeps a NULL.
WHERE on the right of a LEFT JOIN is an INNER JOIN.

text.tspan: LEFT JOIN Shipment s ON s.OrderId = o.Id

svg.text: Put the right-table predicate in ON, not WHERE.
LEFT JOIN keeps orders without a shipment.
EF Where after a left join has the same trap.
-- trap: WHERE on right of LEFT
-- keep the LEFT: filter in ON
